definitions.explanation: The act of sleeping past one's intended wake-up time or later than usual.
A person who habitually sleeps late or has trouble waking up on time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}した→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧。
examples.english: I overslept today and was late.
examples.notes: 朝寝坊⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is the common verb phrase for 'to oversleep'

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}こされる→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: My younger brother is a late riser and always has to be woken up by our mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦くらい→くらい：00647_kurai⟧{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to sleep in at least on my days off.

examples.japanese: {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: I overslept and was late for school.
My child is such a late riser, it's a problem.
examples.notes: Na-adjective usage: {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧

examples.japanese: {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}な⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{起|お}こし→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I always go to wake up my friend who's a late riser.

notes:
{朝寝坊|あさねぼう} means both "oversleeping" and "a person who oversleeps."

FORMS:
